findings.note: RotoWire's Nov 2, 2026 note says Bane hit 5 of 9 threes against Boston and 4 or more threes in three of his last four games, and expects his big role to continue while Banchero (ankle) and Suggs (knee) are out.
ESPN's game log shows Bane playing 34.7 minutes a game, shooting 37.3% from three, and making only about 2 threes against Washington on 11/2. No injury designation was found for him before this game.
RotoWire notes on this page show Bane went 10-for-36 from three in his first four games, including a 1-for-9 game and a 2-for-8 game, so his makes have swung widely from night to night.
